experiment: static observational transfer of fixed TNG50 SKIRT DR1 subhalo 294866
source_sed_reconstruction: linear Fnu versus log emitted wavelength between approximate broadband pivots; no extrapolation
Av_prior: 31 uniformly weighted points from 0 to 3 mag; 61-point robustness
amplitude_prior: uniform positive 0 to 1e6 microJy at emitted 1um normalization; analytically marginalized

population_priors.near_clear: FSPS templates whose supplied effective Av<0.15, pair mixtures and continuum tilts ±0.15
population_priors.broad: all 12 FSPS templates, 48 fixed pair mixtures and same tilts; includes template reddening as conservative degeneracy allowance

aperture_selection: observed r and Ks SNR>5; include other nondetections in linear-flux likelihood
selection_likelihood_limit: no truncation conditioning; marginal z=1 results not calibrated
PSF_provenance: calculator median D50 mapped to Gaussian FWHM; optimistic 0.2arcsec and beta2.5 Moffat alternatives explicitly assumed
noise: sum of independent Poisson source+sky+thermal+moon+dark counts plus N independent Gaussian reads; mean sky known; no real-background injection
inference_inputs: observed aperture flux/errors, observer filters, external SED templates and priors only
not_established: exact K corrections from spectral cubes
